reports.name: USDA Weekly Export Sales (delayed by Veterans Day)

outlook: Grains were mostly steady to slightly mixed in early Tuesday trade as traders squared positions ahead of USDA's November Crop Production and WASDE reports at 11 am CT. December corn was up about a penny near $4.40 after hitting a four-month low Monday, with funds now net short; the trade expects USDA to trim the corn crop and raise soybean production. January soybeans were nearly unchanged near $11.87½, Minneapolis December spring wheat slipped 2¼ cents to $6.20, and Chicago wheat was flat near $5.88. ICE January canola eased C$2.40 to C$755, while Brent crude fell below $90 and markets awaited the October CPI inflation report.
